system.description:
After a successful Strike against an enemy of size Large or smaller, roll a Smarts Check against its CR. If you match or beat it, the enemy is knocked Prone.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.45
system.summary: After a successful Strike against an enemy of size Large or smaller, roll a Smarts Check against its CR. If you match or beat it, the enemy is knocked Prone.

automation.label: Knock Prone
automation.onSuccess: The targeted enemy is knocked Prone.

automation.note: Use after each successful Strike on a Large or smaller enemy; it costs no action. Keep that enemy targeted and set the CR to its CR (or leave it for the Director).
